desc: Design the prefix-power accumulators and update order so the current prefix is not included before counting subarrays ending at \(r\).
Precompute factorials/binomial coefficients or use an \(O(K^2)\) recurrence suitable for \(K\le 10\).
Implement modular arithmetic, input parsing, prefix updates, contribution accumulation, and output.
Verify edge cases such as \(N=1\), zero elements, and \(K=1\).
